description: This file defines a Java class ActiveMQNotificationEventListener which listens to messages from ActiveMQ, processes ObjectMessages containing NotificationData, and delegates the notification data to a listener for further processing.

classes.name: ActiveMQNotificationEventListener
classes.description: A Spring Component that listens for ActiveMQ messages containing notification data, processing ObjectMessages to extract NotificationData and pass it to the notification event listener.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming JMS messages; if the message is an ObjectMessage, casts it to NotificationData and delegates to notificationEventListener.
